objective: This folder is empty. Build a to-do web app with plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript (no npm, no build step), served by `python serve.py --port PORT` using only Python's standard library on 127.0.0.1, with the app at /. Typing in the text box with id `new-todo` and pressing Enter adds the trimmed text as a task (blank input adds nothing) and clears the box. Tasks are `li` items in a list with id `todo-list`, in the order added. Each task has a checkbox that marks it done (its `li` then has the class `done`) and a button labelled `Delete` that removes it. An element with id `count` shows how many tasks are not done, as `1 item left` or `N items left`. Tasks and their done state survive a page reload. It should look clean on desktop and mobile. Add your own checks.
